text.content:
The Princess and the Dragon — Hunt and Continuity Sheet

Prepared template, not current campaign history. Fill only as scenes happen. Book printed pp. 10–11; lair consequences pp. 13, 17, 19, 21. Procedures and overlap rulings: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.229394898ce8db16]{princess and dragon runbook}.

Start the hunt

  • Current status: NOT STARTED. Initial value is 2, or 3 if at least half the PCs fail the panic-orb RESOLVE test.

  • Current value: _ / 6. Last change and reason: ______

  • Session / in-fiction time / location: ________

  • Amy HP: _ / 24. Guardian/companions left with her: ______

  • Scamp travels with: ________

  • Compass state: normal / red. What warning the PCs received: ________

  • Next player-chosen destination and purpose: ________

Trigger at 6 immediately. Select from active hunters, excluding defeated/dissuaded/allied parties. If no hunters remain, the hunt is neutralized. Do not introduce a replacement just to keep a timer running.

Changes to the tracker

Change Trigger
+1 Spend Time
+1 A Wrinkle occurs
+1 An action or failed test wastes time
+1 Encounter hunters and let them leave unhindered
+2 Overnight Rest
As stated A keyed event explicitly advances it
−1 Hinder or throw a hunting party off the trail
−1 Ally with a knight party
−2 Outright defeat a knight party

No increment for a normal successful move alone. Do not charge the same wasted-time event twice under different headings. Separate Wrinkles do add a point. Table ruling: floor at 0; an overnight Rest's +2 replaces the ordinary Spend Time charge. No progress during out-of-game breaks or between sessions unless an in-fiction event occurs. Repeatedly claiming the same alliance is not repeated credit.

Hunting parties

Party Status: active / hindered / allied / dissuaded / defeated Last known location and evidence Next intent
Finnian + Embra + Robin + 8 guards Not yet encountered Unknown Hunting
Stella + Diana + Beck Not yet encountered Unknown Hunting
Raphael + Michelle + Parker + Adagio Not yet encountered Unknown Avoiding violence
Damon + Ulrik Not yet encountered Unknown Hunting

Record any swallowed gem apple here: ____. Living captains will not willingly repeat the trick. Ulrik can be tricked; Damon cannot be pacified. A false alliance with Ulrik is not grounds to remove the threat as genuinely allied.

At the lair

Arrival party: _. Warning delivered: _. PCs' distance in keyed moves: ____.

Party Delay / off-screen damage to Amy
Finnian Allows one keyed move of deliberation, then 4 per move or Spend Time. Table interpretation: delay is one move, not an unlimited window for repeated research.
Stella Immediate attack; 4 per move or Spend Time. Diplomacy during attack at disadvantage.
Raphael No scheduled damage to Amy; receptive to explanation.
Damon + Ulrik Immediate attack; 8 per move or Spend Time.

Table interpretation: apply the book's listed damage directly as the off-screen procedure; do not also roll their attacks or subtract Amy's armor again. Once PCs arrive, resolve the scene normally rather than continuing off-screen damage on top of combat. Explain urgency through the compass before the next voluntary delay.

Track consequences from Amy's actual HP. Do not pre-script her death, reset the tracker to buy extra time, or force Damon to win the arrival roll. Additional hunters can follow as the fiction develops; the book gives no universal reset cycle. State any later progression ruling openly and record it.

Use this to prepare the next session and update campaign state after play. It does not replace the recap.
